reader_summary.overview: Summary: In this eighth episode of the Special Situations Report, hosts Tamanna Suria and Asif Suria discuss the latest developments in the event-driven investing world. They revisit a few top stories - including QXO's hostile bid for Beacon Roofing Supply and insider purchases at the biotech company Ardelyx. The episode continues with an analysis of the nation's largest egg producer, Cal-Maine Foods, and a recently announced buyback at the company.
